raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Follow up on #59857 to enable automatic prefix caching (APC) together with encoder-side SWA bounded replay for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash under PCP in a colocated model instance. The initial PCP implementation rejected APC; this change enables the PCP + APC + encoder-side replay combination.

## Claims

- Enable local APC prefix hits under PCP and rebuild the SWA tail through encoder-side bounded replay while preserving cached compressed KV and indexer keys across ranks.
- Decoder-side tail trimming remains disabled under PCP; scheduled rows execute the normal decoder layers.

## Validation

### Environment

- Model: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
- Hardware: two separate nodes, each with 8x NVIDIA H20 97,871 MiB; driver 535.161.08
- Image: `vllm/vllm-openai:nightly-49cb2bbf71cfd36ee5aa33d1e184b1cddff55294`
- Baseline: the image + prerequisite #59857
- Candidate: the same image and prerequisite + This PR; APC and bounded replay were enabled.
- Common topology: TP2/PCP4, PP1, DCP1, Humming MoE, eager execution, and synchronous scheduling.

Candidate launch command:

```bash
python -m vllm.entrypoints.cli.main serve /models/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash \
  --host 0.0.0.0 \
  --port 18001 \
  --served-model-name deepseek-v4.1-flash \
  --language-model-only \
  --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v41 \
  --attention-backend FLASHMLA_SPARSE_DSV41 \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8_ds_mla \
  --block-size 64 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 2 \
  --pipeline-parallel-size 1 \
  --decode-context-parallel-size 1 \
  --prefill-context-parallel-size 4 \
  --enable-expert-parallel \
  --all2all-backend allgather_reducescatter \
  --engram-config '{"cpu_offload":true}' \
  --moe-backend humming \
  --max-model-len auto \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 4096 \
  --max-num-seqs 64 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 \
  --enable-prefix-caching \
  --swa-bounded-replay \
  --enforce-eager \
  --no-async-scheduling
```

Baseline used the same command except:

```bash
  --no-enable-prefix-caching \
  --no-swa-bounded-replay
```

### Prefix-repetition performance

Both arms ran concurrently with byte-identical deterministic inputs:

```bash
vllm bench serve \
  --backend openai \
  --base-url http://<HOST>:18001 \
  --endpoint /v1/completions \
  --model deepseek-v4.1-flash \
  --tokenizer /tmp/dsv41-tokenizer \
  --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v41 \
  --dataset-name prefix_repetition \
  --prefix-repetition-prefix-len 1024 \
  --prefix-repetition-suffix-len 128 \
  --prefix-repetition-num-prefixes 10 \
  --prefix-repetition-output-len 1 \
  --num-prompts 80 \
  --num-warmups 8 \
  --request-rate inf \
  --max-concurrency 8 \
  --seed 42 \
  --temperature 0 \
  --ignore-eos \
  --percentile-metrics ttft,e2el \
  --disable-tqdm
```

| Metric | Baseline | Candidate | Delta |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Successful requests | 80/80 | 80/80 | - |
| Mean TTFT | 640.73 ms | 386.73 ms | **-39.64%** |
| Median TTFT | 570.56 ms | 346.28 ms | **-39.31%** |
| P99 TTFT | 907.04 ms | 712.10 ms | **-21.49%** |
| Effective input throughput | 13,837.87 tok/s | 22,499.21 tok/s | **+62.59%** |
| Request throughput | 12.01 req/s | 19.53 req/s | **+62.59%** |
| Prefix-cache token hit ratio | disabled | 80,384/101,376 (79.29%) | - |

Every measured request had exactly 1,152 input tokens and one output token. There were no failed requests or Pod restarts.

### Full GSM8K

Both arms ran the same full 1,319-sample ModelScope test split:

```bash
evalscope eval \
  --eval-type openai_api \
  --api-url http://<HOST>:18001/v1 \
  --api-key EMPTY \
  --model deepseek-v4.1-flash \
  --model-id deepseek-v4.1-flash \
  --datasets gsm8k \
  --dataset-hub modelscope \
  --dataset-args '{"gsm8k":{"few_shot_num":4}}' \
  --seed 42 \
  --eval-batch-size 64 \
  --generation-config '{"temperature":0.0,"top_p":1.0,"max_tokens":8192,"reasoning_effort":"high","seed":42,"timeout":10000}' \
  --timeout 10000
```

EvalScope version: 1.11.1.

| Metric | Baseline | Candidate |
|---|---:|---:|
| Accuracy | 1279/1319 (96.97%) | 1284/1319 (97.35%) |
| API errors | 0 | 0 |

Paired outcomes were 1,277 both correct, 33 both wrong, 7 candidate-only correct, and 2 baseline-only correct. The exact two-sided McNemar p-value was `0.1797`, so the observed `+0.38 pp` accuracy difference is not statistically significant. Candidate GSM8K traffic recorded 674,816/803,206 local prefix-cache hit tokens (84.02%).

## Details

Reuse the existing scheduler replay boundary and padding kernel, stage replay starts per local PCP segment, mask each rank's own cacheable slots, and gather those slots back in the same rank-major order as KV publication. All ranks participate even when a peer has no replay rows; SWA and compressor scratch mappings stay unchanged. The additional slot metadata collective applies only to PCP batches with encoder replay enabled. Production changes are confined to DeepSeek-V4.1 files, with the existing non-PCP path and other PCP restrictions retained.

This does not duplicate #61554, which targets cold-prefill decoder trimming with prefix caching disabled. Enable APC and encoder-side replay with `--enable-prefix-caching --swa-bounded-replay`. The supported scope is NVIDIA CUDA, MRV2, eager execution, synchronous scheduling and PP=DP=DCP=1. KV connectors, speculative decoding, microbatching and MegaMoE remain unsupported with PCP. AI assistance was used for implementation and Codex CLI review; human line-by-line review remains pending, while GPU/model validation is documented above.

---

<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>
